episode_notes: Genre: Office comedy and romcom web series. Lead characters: Shanmukh Jaswant (Shannu), an ambitious and meticulous software engineer, his superhero-obsessed teammates Marvel Manohar and DC Don, tomboy colleague Harika, chill manager Arvind, and bubbly new recruit Vaishnavi.
